src/approval-coordinator.ts.name: Approval prompts
src/approval-coordinator.ts.description: Queues prompts for the user, applies their answer only to the scopes shown, and handles cancellation and default rules.

src/approval-envelope.ts.name: Approval request snapshot
src/approval-envelope.ts.description: Makes a safe, fixed copy of a request's data before it is shown for approval, so it cannot change afterwards.

src/permission-admission.ts.name: Start-up admission
src/permission-admission.ts.description: Checks a napplet's declared interfaces before it runs, so only approved domains are switched on for it.

src/permission-runtime.ts.name: Scoped approval engine
src/permission-runtime.ts.description: Decides whether an operation is approved, asks the user if needed, tracks how long grants last and withdraws them on revoke.

src/permission-state.ts.name: Saved approvals
src/permission-state.ts.description: Keeps remembered approvals and writes them through the host, failing loudly if a save does not succeed.
